GitHub queued listing itself is sometimes inconsistent with per-ID GET.

Treating queued-list count 0 as deleted evidence
Excluding run IDs merely because they are old
Applying a raw numerical discount without exact provider/zero-job evidence
Repeating provider-denied API cancellation and deletion
